extraction.tier_rationale: Population (NONMEM, mixed-effects) model from 63 post-CABG patients sedated by TCI for >= 6 h, 1,681 arterial samples, LVEF > 25%. The authors preferred this simple model over the BSA-covariate one, which cross-validation did not confirm. PK-only: no effect-site link was estimated. Absolute volumes/clearances; weight is required only for per-kg dosing. Its Vss (330 L) is ~2.8x the healthy-volunteer Buhrer set's (118 L).

source_review.notes: V1 32.2, V2 53, V3 245 L; Cl1 0.43, Cl2 0.56, Cl3 0.39 L/min and the CVs (58, 16, 71, 40, 56, 68%) match the digest's Table 3 'Present study' column. HUMAN ITEMS: confirm against the primary PDF, and resolve whether the printed CV% is exact (curated) or sqrt(omega2) (TRAP 1).

notes: The critically-ill half of the midazolam divergence pair: the same drug, a 2.8x larger steady-state volume and a smaller clearance after cardiac surgery. It is the first Hypnos model with ejection-fraction standing (LVEF > 25% was an inclusion criterion). Its BSV band is the first one on a non-propofol/remifentanil drug.
